# Allele frequencies for all SNPs for each level of each requested facet.

Fetch allele frequencies for all SNPs for each level of all the
requested facets. Major and minor allele frequencies will be
interleaved, with the major allele first for each locus.

## Usage

``` r
tabulate_allele_frequency_matrix(x, facets = NULL)
```

## Arguments

- x:

  snpRdata object

- facets:

  character, default NULL. The facets for which to calculate allele
  frequencies. See
  [`Facets_in_snpR`](https://hemstrow.github.io/snpR/reference/Facets_in_snpR.md)
  for details.

## Value

A named, nested list containing allele frequency matrices for each facet
level for all requested facets, merged into the provided snpRdata
object.

## Author

William Hemstrom

## Examples

``` r
# base level
d <- tabulate_allele_frequency_matrix(stickSNPs)
get.snpR.stats(d, stats = "allele_frequency_matrix")
```
